test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the option that does NOT contain an adverb.

options.text: Maya was quite absent-minded during class today.
She ran swiftly to catch the thief.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An **adverb** modifies a verb, adjective, or another adverb, often describing how, when, where, or to what degree an action occurs.
 
• In the sentence "**Rohit loves chocolate**", there is **no adverb** because the sentence consists only of a subject ("Rohit"), verb ("loves"), and object ("chocolate").
 
• Other options contain adverbs: 
 
 
• **Option 1:** "Never" is an adverb modifying the verb "forgets" to indicate frequency.
 
• **Option 2:** "Quite" is an adverb modifying the adjective "absent-minded" to indicate degree.
 
• **Option 4:** "Swiftly" is an adverb modifying the verb "ran" to describe the manner of running.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Rohit loves chocolate."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Adverbs typically answer questions like: How? When? Where? To what extent?
 
• Examples of adverbs include: "never," "quite," "swiftly," "often," "very," "here," etc.
